jobs.description:
🤖 About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Owner with 5-10 years of experience, working on AI-related projects to join our growing team.

You will be working on some of the most challenging and impactful projects across our banking and financial services clients. You will contribute to internal initiatives focused on building and deploying AI solutions to expand the company's offering.

 

📊 You will:

• Oversee products around Virtual Assistants, Autonomous Agents, Speech-to-text & many more
• Clarify the product's functional specifications according to the agile methodology
• Work with and manage business stakeholders (internal clients) on defining needs/requirements and delivering high-value products to them
• Need strategic thinking to develop and convey a compelling 3y product vision
• Work in squads of 6-10 Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and UX/UI Designers, reporting to the Cluster Product Owner.
• Build & Prioritise a robust Backlog Management around the business' strategic needs
• Understand product dependencies, and identify roadblocks in the product cycle
• Continuous planning and turning the product vision into reality
• Collaborate with Scrum Masters 
📊 You bring to the table:

• 5-10 years of experience as a Product Owner / Product Manager
• Extensive experience across Banking / FinTech
• Demonstrated ability in deploying and scaling AI Solutions (Chatbots, VAs, Speech-to-text, etc.)
• Strategic thinking around designing and building product roadmaps
 

🗣¿ Language Skills

Fluency in English and French/Dutch

 

🤹 Other Skills

• Experience with Scrum or Agile methods is a great plus for us.
• We are looking for proactive problem-solvers
• You'll be working independently & autonomously
• Passion for growing, building, and continuous learning, especially around the developments within AI and Data Science 
🎁 What's in it for you

💸 A competitive salary and benefits package.

🦾 Working on cutting-edge projects with leading banking clients, in a startup environment

💿 Exposure to a wide array of AI and data science technologies.

🫂 Mentorship from Directors and Partners with backgrounds from renowned companies like Google, PayPal, Semetis, and Sia Partners.

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!
 

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.
 

Your Responsibilities
 

 
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
 
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
 
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
 
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
 
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
 
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas. 

 
• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).
 
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
 
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
 
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
 
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch.
 
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
 
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
 
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
 
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
 
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
 
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
 
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
 
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.

Join Kuehne+Nagel in Geel as an experienced order picker and earn €16,3753/hour plus €8 meal vouchers working in a 2-shift system!

In this varied role, you will combine active order picking with quality control and warehouse administration. You will ensure top quality for renowned brands and make sure every shipment is in perfect condition.

Ready to take the next step in your logistics career? Send your CV to talentcenter4@randstad.be or call us directly at 014 24 86 60!

VG 458/BUOSA

What are we looking for in a candidate?

• Minimum of 6 months to 1 year of experience in a warehouse setting or order picking.
• Proven experience working with a handheld scanner is required.
• Good command of either Dutch or English.
• Willing to work in a 2-shift rotation on a long-term basis.
• Must have your own transport to commute to the site in Geel.
Your main duties as an order picker:

• Order picking goods in the warehouse using a handheld scanner.
• Conducting accurate quality control checks on picked orders.
• Checking and monitoring physical inventory and stock discrepancies.
• Handling the required warehouse administration within the system.
• Reporting deviations and safeguarding overall quality standards.

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:
The Transport Officer is responsible for the daily monitoring and coordination of transport shipments within Europe and to/from non-EU countries. The role ensures that transportation activities are carried out on time, efficiently, and in accordance with established requirements and service levels. The Transport Officer serves as a key link and point of contact between internal teams, freight forwarders/carriers, suppliers, and logistics partners.

Your responsibilities:
Follow-up and monitoring

• Follow up on EU and non-EU transport shipments from booking through to delivery.
• Monitor transport statuses, transit times, and scheduled deliveries.
• Proactively follow up on delays, deviations, and other operational issues.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date transport administration and reporting.

Carrier / Freight Forwarder Management

• Request and follow up on transport bookings; evaluate and approve transport movements in accordance with specified service requirements.
• In consultation with the manager, select and assign carriers for specific transport routes and freight flows.
• Identify, monitor, coordinate, and escalate structural issues involving transport partners.

KPI and Performance Management

• Monitor and report on carrier performance and identify trends.
• Discuss performance issues with partners, propose improvement actions, and follow up on their implementation.
• Coordinate actions with internal and external stakeholders and contribute to the continuous improvement of transport performance.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree level or equivalent through relevant experience.
• Proficiency in standard software applications (MS Office).
• Good knowledge of transport processes, freight forwarding, and the logistics industry.
• Understanding of performance management and strong analytical skills.
• Works in a structured and accurate manner, with strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• Able to anticipate potential issues and correctly assess their possible impact.
• Capable of analysing problems quickly and accurately and proposing practical solutions.
• You speak French or Dutch, you also have a good knowledge of technical English.

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Are you precise, curious, and hands-on? At Procter & Gamble (P&G) Strombeek - Bever, we are looking for an Associate Researcher to play a key role in carrying out applied research within our innovative R&D organization. This is a temporary position with a maximum duration of one year.

What you'll do

As an Associate Researcher, you will perform daily experimental work in a laboratory, pilot plant, or production environment. Working closely with a technical coach or manager, you will help deliver reliable and reproducible research outcomes that drive our projects forward.

Execute standardized test methods and experiments.

Document and summarize experimental data for review and interpretation.

Report results and observations, highlighting any unexpected findings

Work in accordance with quality assurance and safety standards.

Collaborate with colleagues and make effective use of available tools and resources.

Develop computer skills relevant to data recording, analysis, and reporting.
Who you are

You have a degree in a scientific or technical field (e.g., chemistry, biology, process technology, or related)

You are practical, eager to learn, and have strong attention to detail.

You can work independently after initial training.

You speak very good Englisch (other languages are a plus) 

Previous lab experience is beneficial but not required – we provide thorough training.

jobs.occupation: Asset Management Engineer Civil & Structural Assets
jobs.description:
As an Industrial Asset Management Engineer, you join the asset team at an industrial production site in Hoboken. You help build, implement and improve the asset management approach for civil structures and building assets. Asset management is the core discipline, with civil and structural engineering as application domain.

You focus on tactical asset planning, maintenance strategy and lifecycle management. You also capture operational complaints, technical issues and improvement opportunities, and translate them into concrete actions and proposals.

• Contribute to the design, implementation and rollout of the asset management system for civil and building assets.
• Help structure processes, asset registers, asset hierarchies, criticality frameworks, maintenance logic, KPIs and documentation flows.
• Translate asset management principles such as ISO 55000, risk-based decision-making and lifecycle thinking into practical methods for an industrial environment.
• Support the embedding of this way of working with production, maintenance and engineering stakeholders.
• Develop tactical plans to improve the reliability, safety and lifetime of civil and building assets.
• Create, maintain and optimize multi-year maintenance plans.
• Define and follow up performance indicators for civil and structural asset management.
• Translate risks, degradation insights and operational opportunities into maintenance strategies, improvement actions and project proposals.
• Investigate degradation, deficiencies and incidents to reduce structural risks.
• Carry out root cause analyses for recurring technical issues and structural deficiencies.
• Interpret inspection data, trends, degradation curves and remaining-life assessments.
• Use criticality and risk analysis to prioritize interventions and lifecycle measures.
• Formulate preventive and mitigating actions and convert them into practical maintenance strategies.
• Prepare interventions to an execution-ready level, including scope, technical descriptions, permits, safety conditions, materials, contractor input and planning constraints.
• Transfer complete work packages to the work coordinator and use execution feedback to improve future plans and strategies.
• Translate measures into practical civil and structural improvement actions.
• Define scope, risks, planning and budget for smaller interventions on buildings and structures.
• Coordinate contractors and condition-monitoring partners during engineering and execution.
• Provide technical guidance, quality follow-up and documentation support for assigned interventions.
• Prepare project scope documents and CAPEX/OPEX proposals where needed.
• Advise engineering and design stakeholders on lifecycle-impacting parameters for structural assets.
• Review designs and as-built documentation against structural, reliability and maintainability criteria.
• Support acceptance criteria, validation checklists and handover conditions.
• Safeguard compliance with applicable standards and regulations, including ISO 55000, SEVESO and Eurocode where relevant.
• Ensure correct and high-quality asset data management in EAM and DMS systems.
Location: Hoboken, Belgium. Full-time onsite presence is required. Occasional homeworking may be possible subject to prior alignment and approval.

• You have hands-on experience in industrial asset management, with a strong focus on tactical asset planning, maintenance strategy, criticality-based decision-making and lifecycle management.
• You have experience with the implementation of an asset management system in an industrial environment.
• You hold a master's degree in engineering. A background in civil or construction engineering is an advantage, but candidates from other engineering disciplines are also considered if they have grown into asset management and have demonstrable civil/structural affinity.
• You bring solid civil / structural knowledge & experience; this is an essential requirement for the role.
• You have demonstrable affinity with construction and civil engineering.
• You have working knowledge of ISO 55000, SEVESO and Eurocode.
• You are able to analyse technical and inspection data and translate findings into practical maintenance strategies and improvement proposals.
• You have experience with or exposure to methodologies such as RBI data interpretation, RCA, criticality analysis, risk analysis, degradation analysis and remaining-life assessment, and you are motivated to deepen your expertise further.
• You have experience coordinating projects and collaborating with contractors, inspectors or other external partners.
• Experience in a mature industrial asset management environment is a plus.
• Experience with EAM systems, DMS platforms, inspection databases, spreadsheets for degradation models or predictive analysis tools is an asset.
• Experience with industrial structures, corrosion issues, cracking, renovation works or smaller civil interventions is a plus.
• Experience with work preparation in an industrial maintenance or turnaround context is an advantage.
• You take ownership, communicate clearly and work effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
• You combine problem-solving ability, learning agility and the motivation to further specialize in asset management.
• You are fluent in English and Dutch, both spoken and written. Other languages are a plus.

CLdN is an international logistics player with a strong European network and a clear focus on efficient and sustainable maritime connections. For CLdN RoRo Agencies NV in Zeebrugge, we are looking for a motivated Customs & Border Compliance Officer for the logistics department.
 

JOB DESCRIPTION
 

As a Customs & Border Compliance Officer, you will follow up on all customs and compliance activities within Shipping, Port and Door-to-Door processes. You act as the link between internal teams, customers and authorities, ensuring a smooth and compliant flow of goods.
 
 

• Manage customs formalities and ensure compliance with applicable legislation. 

• Apply for and follow up on permits (AEO, bonded warehouse, temporary storage, …) and liaise with 

customs and port authorities. 

• Act as the point of contact for customs-related matters and support internal and external stakeholders. 

• Prepare and improve procedures, KPIs and reporting. 

• Optimize processes and resolve operational issues. 

PROFILE
 
 

• You have a very good command of Dutch and English; additional languages are a plus. 

• You preferably have a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics or a related field, with some exposure to customs, or are willing to quickly develop this expertise. 

• You preferably have experience or knowledge in customs, shipping or port operations, or are willing to quickly develop this expertise. 

• You are eager to learn and able to quickly process and master a large amount of complex information and legislation. 

• You have a hands-on mentality and strong problem-solving skills. 

• You possess excellent communication skills and easily build relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 

• You are willing to participate in an on-call rotation (approximately every 12 weeks, including weekends/evenings).

Job description
 

● As a Project and Engineering Manager - BESS you’ll drive the engineering and 

execution of major BESS projects (typically >100M EUR investment).
 

● You are responsible for overseeing multidisciplinary design across electrical, civil, 

and structural engineering domains..
 

● You supervise EPC partners, engineering firms, consultants, and other external 

stakeholders throughout all phases, and coordinate internal teams including 

development, procurement, construction, and HSE.
 

● As a Project and Engineering Manager - BESS you prepare technical specifications 

and lead tendering processes with suppliers, integrators, and contractors..
 

● You manage key technical domains such as: BESS system architecture, HV/MV 

substations, grid interconnection, cabling, electrical infrastructure, civil works, site 

infrastructure, etc.
 

● As a Project and Engineering Manager - BESS you closely follow the project 

planning, make adjustments where necessary, and report on the project progress 

and the milestones.

Your profile
 

● You have a Master degree in Engineering (Electrical, Industrial, Civil, …) or 

equivalent level of education.
 

● You have relevant experience in engineering or construction of large-scale energy or 

infrastructure projects (BESS or renewables preferred).
 

● Solid understanding of project development, permitting, and grid connection 

procedures.
 

● You have strong coordinating skills and are able of successfully managing all parties 

involved.
 

● Excellent knowledge of English and French, able to communicate in Dutch is a plus.
 

● You are communicative, have strong people skills and can take initiative.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager CAPEX Process Industry
jobs.description:
Project overview

For this role, you will lead complex multidisciplinary CAPEX projects within the process industry. You are accountable for scope, budget, timing, quality and safety across both greenfield developments and major modifications to existing industrial facilities.

Primary tasks & responsibilities

• Direct industrial engineering projects from concept and feasibility through engineering, execution, commissioning and final handover to operations.
• Define and manage project scope, deliverables, budget, business case, investment approval and baseline planning in MS Project.
• Coordinate all project phases, including pre-study, concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement, contractor selection, construction, site execution, commissioning and operational transfer.
• Act as the key point of accountability for internal stakeholders and management.
• Lead multidisciplinary teams across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS disciplines, working closely with both internal and external parties.
• Manage scope changes, risks, claims and deviations that affect budget, schedule or delivery.
• Report in a structured way on project progress, issues and decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• You bring at least 10 years of experience as a Project Manager, with proven end-to-end ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• You also have at least 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in areas such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• You have solid experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting, investment approval and the commissioning of industrial installations.
• Background in the process industry is essential.
• You have strong practical expertise in MS Project and take real ownership of project planning instead of limiting yourself to follow-up activities.
• You combine an academic level of thinking with strong analytical skills and a broad helicopter view.
Non-technical profile requirements

• You work autonomously and assume full ownership of your responsibilities.
• You show strong leadership and know how to challenge stakeholders and contractors when required.
• You communicate clearly and effectively with stakeholders at every level of the organisation.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial environments.
Methodology / certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is considered a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer: English + Czech + Polish OR Lituanian - Multiple shifts - Oostakker
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.
 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English + Czech, and Lithuanian and/or Polish 

 
• You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

As Office Manager, you will be at the heart of the Brussels office, ensuring that everything runs smoothly. You will combine service excellence and operational responsibility whilst working closely with local and international teams to support the day-to-day running of the office and contribute to wider firm initiatives. 

Your Responsibilities
  
• Manage facilities and office services, ensuring the workplace is well equipped, maintained and ready to support colleagues' daily work.  
• Shape the workplace and employee experience to support team growth by identifying practical opportunities to make the Brussels office more welcoming, efficient and well organised.  
• Lead and develop the reception team, creating a high-quality experience for colleagues, clients and visitors. 
• In collaboration with diverse stakeholders (HR, IT, Marketing, the Social Committee as well as international teams) coordinate and deliver office projects and events including client seminars and team building initiatives  
• Build and manage strong supplier relationships, ensuring quality service and value for money.  
• Contribute to Health & Safety, Security, Risk Management, Business Continuity and GDPR  helping maintain a safe and supportive workplace.  
• Encourage ESG initiatives and contribute to the firm's sustainability objectives in Brussels.  
• Participate in the global Office Management quarterly meetings, sharing best practices and bringing innovative ideas to the Brussels office.  
 
• You have minimum 5 years' experience in Office Management and an interest in how office management is evolving through new systems and technologies.  
• Excellent English, with good knowledge of Dutch and French 
• A proactive and motivating leadership style. 
• Clear and confident communication skills. 
• A collaborative "one team" mindset, enabling you to build strong working relationships. 
• Integrity, professionalism and a strong sense of ownership. 
• A creative and practical approach to problem-solving.

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.

You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.

Client Details

An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

Description

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.

You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.

This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.

 

What you will do

• Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
• Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
• Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners
• Manage customer and partner communication via email and web portal, ensuring speed, clarity, and professionalism
• Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Order Processing, Finance, and Operations
• Prepare and manage documents using structured templates and standardized procedures
• Monitor incoming and outgoing requests, documentation, and order statuses, and proactively resolve issues
• Ensure strict compliance with internal procedures and company policies, working in a detailed and precise manner
• Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
• Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
• Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication
 

What you bring to the table

• At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
• Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
• A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
• Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
• Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
